# Industries

How ColdOps approaches each kind of business: which pages it reads first, which defects matter most there, what it can offer, what it must never claim, the words the industry uses about its own customers, and the Google Maps searches that find more of them.

## Accountancy enquiry and onboarding

Enquiries cluster hard around filing deadlines and go to whoever replies first; onboarding a new client is a paperwork problem.

**Pages read first:** `/contact`, `/enquiry`, `/services`, `/get-a-quote`, `/about`

**What matters most here:**

- How quickly an enquiry can be made and answered (`enquiry_speed`, conversion)
- Steps to get an indicative fee (`quote_friction`, conversion)
- How much of onboarding happens on paper (`onboarding_paperwork`, follow_up)

| Offer | What it delivers | Needs a finding of type | Est. value |
|---|---|---|---|
| Enquiry intake | A short enquiry form routed to the right person | `high_friction_contact_form`, `no_booking_or_enquiry_path` | $3,000 |
| Consultation scheduling | Self-service consultation booking with reminders | `broken_primary_cta`, `no_booking_or_enquiry_path` | $2,600 |
| Client onboarding | Collecting documents and details without email ping-pong | `no_booking_or_enquiry_path`, `no_visible_phone_number` | $2,400 |
| Website conversion improvements | Fixes to the paths that lose an enquiry | `broken_internal_link`, `broken_primary_cta`, `high_friction_contact_form`, `javascript_console_errors`, `missing_mobile_viewport`, `no_booking_or_enquiry_path`, `no_visible_phone_number`, `slow_largest_contentful_paint` | $2,600 |

**Never claim:**

- Never state or imply a tax saving
- Never suggest the firm is non-compliant

**In their words:**

- Called a *firm*; the page that matters is the *enquiry page*.
- Why a conversion defect matters to them: Accountancy enquiries cluster around filing deadlines and go to whoever answers first, so anything in the way there costs a client rather than a visit.
- Why a quality defect matters: It is a relatively small technical issue, but it affects how some visitors navigate the site and removes useful context from those pages.
- Why an operational gap matters: An enquiry that arrives in the evening waits until somebody opens the inbox, and a business shopping for an accountant has usually written to three.

**Searches that find them:** accountants, chartered accountants, bookkeepers, tax advisors, payroll services, company formation agents

## Clinic booking and patient follow-up

Private clinics and small medical practices. The gap is almost never the website: it is that every appointment goes through a telephone answered during office hours, so an enquiry arriving at eight in the evening waits until tomorrow or goes to whoever answers first.

**Pages read first:** `/appointments`, `/book`, `/new-patients`, `/patients`, `/services`, `/contact`, `/fees`

**What matters most here:**

- Whether an appointment can be made without telephoning (`appointment_booking`, booking)
- How a new patient registers (`new_patient_flow`, conversion)
- What happens to an enquiry outside opening hours (`out_of_hours_enquiry`, conversion)
- Whether appointment reminders are automated (`appointment_reminders`, retention)
- Whether lapsed patients are re-engaged (`patient_reactivation`, retention)
- Whether fees and what is covered are explained (`fees_and_cover`, content)

| Offer | What it delivers | Needs a finding of type | Est. value |
|---|---|---|---|
| Online appointment booking | Self-service appointment booking for new and existing patients | `high_friction_contact_form`, `no_booking_or_enquiry_path`, `no_self_service_booking` | $2,800 |
| Out-of-hours enquiry handling | An assistant that answers and captures enquiries when the desk is closed | `no_conversational_capability`, `no_visible_phone_number` | $3,200 |
| Appointment reminder automation | Automatic reminders before an appointment and recall afterwards | `no_follow_up_automation` | $2,200 |
| Review collection | Automatic review requests after a visit | `no_review_automation` | $1,600 |
| Accessibility remediation | Correcting the accessibility faults found on the site | `images_missing_alt_text`, `serious_accessibility_violations` | $1,200 |
| Page speed work | Cutting the time the main content takes to appear | `failed_network_requests`, `slow_largest_contentful_paint` | $1,500 |
| Search listing improvements | Giving search engines the summary and structure to read | `missing_meta_description`, `no_structured_data` | $900 |
| Site reliability fixes | Clearing the errors and gaps that break pages for some visitors | `broken_internal_link`, `javascript_console_errors`, `missing_mobile_viewport`, `missing_security_headers` | $1,000 |

**Never claim:**

- any handling, storage or processing of patient records
- any clinical, diagnostic or triage capability
- any claim about patient outcomes or waiting times

**In their words:**

- Called a *clinic*; the page that matters is the *appointments page*.
- Why a conversion defect matters to them: Anyone who got that far had decided to book, so the break costs an appointment rather than a browse.
- Why a quality defect matters: It is a small thing, but it makes parts of the site harder to use and costs those pages some of their context.
- Why an operational gap matters: Somebody deciding at nine in the evening has to wait for the desk to open, and the ones who do not wait ring whoever answers first.

**Pages read first:** `/book`, `/booking`, `/appointments`, `/new-patients`, `/contact`, `/emergency`, `/fees`

- Whether fees and cover are explained (`insurance_information`, content)
- Whether lapsed patients are re-engaged (`patient_reactivation`, retention)

## General business fallback

Used when the industry is unknown. Identifies the dominant conversion event from what the site actually offers, then works only from evidenced friction on that path. Never opens with a generic 'your business could use AI' framing.

**Pages read first:** `/contact`, `/about`, `/services`, `/pricing`, `/book`

**What matters most here:**

- The main action the site asks visitors to take (`dominant_conversion`, conversion)
- How hard it is to make contact (`contact_friction`, conversion)
- Errors, speed, and mobile usability (`technical_health`, technical)
- Whether enquiries appear to be followed up (`followup`, follow_up)

| Offer | What it delivers | Needs a finding of type | Est. value |
|---|---|---|---|
| Website conversion improvements | Fixes to the path that loses the most high-intent visitors | `broken_internal_link`, `broken_primary_cta`, `high_friction_contact_form`, `javascript_console_errors`, `missing_mobile_viewport`, `no_booking_or_enquiry_path`, `no_visible_phone_number`, `slow_largest_contentful_paint` | $2,000 |
| Enquiry automation | Capture and follow-up for enquiries | `high_friction_contact_form`, `no_booking_or_enquiry_path` | $1,800 |

**Never claim:**

- Never assert an industry-specific problem without evidence from this site
- Never open with a generic claim that the business needs AI

**In their words:**

- Called a *business*; the page that matters is the *contact page*.
- Why a conversion defect matters to them: Because it affects getting in touch, it is likely to be interrupting visitors at a fairly high-intent point rather than while they browse.
- Why a quality defect matters: It is a small technical issue, but it affects how some visitors use the site and removes useful context from those pages.
- Why an operational gap matters: An enquiry that arrives outside working hours waits until somebody opens the inbox, and most people who enquire have enquired elsewhere too.

- What happens to an enquiry outside office hours (`out_of_hours_enquiry`, conversion)

- Whether reviews are collected and shown (`review_presence`, content)

| Page speed work | Cutting the time the main content takes to appear | `failed_network_requests`, `slow_largest_contentful_paint` | $1,500 |
| Search listing improvements | Giving search engines the summary and structure to read | `missing_meta_description`, `no_structured_data` | $900 |

- Called a *brokerage*; the page that matters is the *quote page*.
- Why a conversion defect matters to them: Anyone who reached that point was asking for a quote, so the break costs an enquiry that had already chosen you.
- Why a quality defect matters: It is a small thing, but it makes parts of the site harder to use and costs those pages some of their context.
- Why an operational gap matters: A quote asked for on a Saturday sits until Monday, and a renewal nobody chases is a policy that quietly moves elsewhere.

## Property enquiry routing and follow-up

Speed of response to a property enquiry is the dominant variable; most losses are routing and follow-up failures, not marketing.

**Pages read first:** `/properties`, `/listings`, `/contact`, `/valuation`, `/book-viewing`, `/agents`

**What matters most here:**

- How a property enquiry is captured and routed (`enquiry_response`, conversion)
- Whether enquiries reach the right agent (`lead_routing`, automation)
- Whether agent contact details are visible (`agent_contact_visibility`, conversion)
- Whether listings appear current (`listing_freshness`, content)
- Whether a viewing can be booked online (`viewing_booking`, booking)
- Buyer and seller nurture sequences (`nurture`, follow_up)

| Offer | What it delivers | Needs a finding of type | Est. value |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lead routing | Enquiries routed to the right agent with escalation | `high_friction_contact_form`, `no_booking_or_enquiry_path` | $3,200 |
| Viewing scheduling | Self-service viewing booking | `broken_primary_cta`, `no_booking_or_enquiry_path` | $2,600 |
| Automated follow-up | Structured follow-up for unanswered enquiries | `no_booking_or_enquiry_path`, `no_visible_phone_number` | $2,400 |
| Website conversion improvements | Fixes to enquiry and listing paths | `broken_internal_link`, `broken_primary_cta`, `high_friction_contact_form`, `javascript_console_errors`, `missing_mobile_viewport`, `no_booking_or_enquiry_path`, `no_visible_phone_number`, `slow_largest_contentful_paint` | $2,800 |

**Never claim:**

- Never make property valuation or market-direction claims

**In their words:**

- Called a *agency*; the page that matters is the *enquiry page*.
- Why a conversion defect matters to them: Somebody on that page has already found a property they want to ask about rather than browsing, so the break sits right at the enquiry.
- Why a quality defect matters: It is a small technical issue, but it affects how some visitors work through the listings and removes context from those pages.
- Why an operational gap matters: A property enquiry that lands in a shared inbox waits for whoever opens it, and a buyer who has enquired on one house has usually enquired on three.

**Searches that find them:** estate agents, letting agents, property management companies, commercial property agents, buying agents, student accommodation agents, holiday letting agents

## Restaurant reputation and reservations

Reputation and the reservation path drive covers; menu availability on mobile is the most common silent failure.

**Pages read first:** `/menu`, `/menus`, `/reservations`, `/book`, `/booking`, `/contact`, `/about`

**What matters most here:**

- Public review volume, rating and responses (`reputation`, reputation)
- Whether a table can be reserved online (`reservation_flow`, booking)
- Whether the menu is readable on mobile (`menu_availability`, content)
- Overall mobile usability (`mobile_experience`, technical)
- Structured data and local listing signals (`local_seo`, content)
- Whether calls are the only booking route (`missed_calls`, follow_up)

| Offer | What it delivers | Needs a finding of type | Est. value |
|---|---|---|---|
| Reputation management | Review monitoring and response workflow | `no_structured_data` | $1,400 |
| Reservation automation | Online reservations with confirmation and reminders | `broken_primary_cta`, `no_booking_or_enquiry_path` | $2,000 |
| Review-request workflow | Automatic review requests after a visit | `no_structured_data`, `no_visible_phone_number` | $1,100 |
| Website and menu fixes | Fixes to menu and booking paths | `broken_internal_link`, `broken_primary_cta`, `high_friction_contact_form`, `javascript_console_errors`, `missing_mobile_viewport`, `no_booking_or_enquiry_path`, `no_visible_phone_number`, `slow_largest_contentful_paint` | $1,800 |

**Never claim:**

- Never make claims about food safety or hygiene ratings

**In their words:**

- Called a *restaurant*; the page that matters is the *booking page*.
- Why a conversion defect matters to them: Someone on that page is usually trying to book a table rather than read the menu, so the break sits right at the reservation.
- Why a quality defect matters: It is a small issue, but it makes parts of the site harder to use and removes context from those pages.
- Why an operational gap matters: A booking request made after service has finished waits until somebody opens the inbox, by which point the table has often gone.

**Searches that find them:** restaurants, fine dining restaurants, bistros, gastropubs, wine bars, private dining venues, event caterers

## Salon and barber appointment booking

A chair empty at two o'clock is revenue that cannot be recovered, and the whole business runs on rebooking.

**Pages read first:** `/book`, `/booking`, `/appointments`, `/services`, `/contact`

**What matters most here:**

- Whether an appointment can be booked without ringing (`appointment_booking`, conversion)
- Whether the next visit is booked automatically (`rebooking`, follow_up)
- Whether appointments are reminded (`no_show_reminders`, follow_up)

| Offer | What it delivers | Needs a finding of type | Est. value |
|---|---|---|---|
| Online appointment booking | Self-service booking that fills the quiet hours | `broken_primary_cta`, `no_booking_or_enquiry_path` | $2,000 |
| Reminders and rebooking | Automatic reminders and a prompt to book the next visit | `no_booking_or_enquiry_path`, `no_visible_phone_number` | $1,600 |
| Enquiry intake | A short enquiry form routed to the salon | `high_friction_contact_form` | $1,400 |
| Website conversion improvements | Fixes to the booking path | `broken_internal_link`, `broken_primary_cta`, `high_friction_contact_form`, `javascript_console_errors`, `missing_mobile_viewport`, `no_booking_or_enquiry_path`, `no_visible_phone_number`, `slow_largest_contentful_paint` | $1,800 |

**In their words:**

- Called a *salon*; the page that matters is the *booking page*.
- Why a conversion defect matters to them: Anyone clicking there has already chosen a service and a rough time, so the break costs an appointment rather than a browse.
- Why a quality defect matters: It is a small thing, but it makes parts of the site harder to use and costs those pages some of their context.
- Why an operational gap matters: Somebody deciding on a Sunday evening cannot book until the salon opens, and a chair empty on Tuesday afternoon is not revenue you can get back.

**Searches that find them:** hair salons, barbershops, beauty salons, nail salons, brow and lash bars, hair extension salons, tanning salons

## Veterinary appointment booking and registration

New-client registration and same-day appointment requests dominate: a worried owner rings the first practice that answers.

**Pages read first:** `/contact`, `/appointments`, `/register`, `/new-clients`, `/services`, `/emergency`

**What matters most here:**

- How quickly an appointment can be requested (`appointment_request`, conversion)
- Steps to register a new pet (`registration_friction`, conversion)
- Whether the out-of-hours route is findable (`out_of_hours_route`, conversion)

| Offer | What it delivers | Needs a finding of type | Est. value |
|---|---|---|---|
| Online appointment booking | Self-service appointment booking with confirmations | `broken_primary_cta`, `no_booking_or_enquiry_path` | $2,400 |
| New-client registration | A short registration form that reaches the practice system | `high_friction_contact_form`, `no_booking_or_enquiry_path` | $2,000 |
| Appointment reminders | Automatic reminders for appointments and boosters | `no_booking_or_enquiry_path`, `no_visible_phone_number` | $1,800 |
| Website conversion improvements | Fixes to the paths that lose an owner mid-enquiry | `broken_internal_link`, `broken_primary_cta`, `high_friction_contact_form`, `javascript_console_errors`, `missing_mobile_viewport`, `no_booking_or_enquiry_path`, `no_visible_phone_number`, `slow_largest_contentful_paint` | $2,200 |

**Never claim:**

- Never imply a clinical outcome for an animal
- Never suggest the practice is failing a duty of care

**In their words:**

- Called a *practice*; the page that matters is the *appointment page*.
- Why a conversion defect matters to them: An owner on that page is usually worried about an animal rather than browsing, and they will ring the next practice on the list instead.
- Why a quality defect matters: It is a small technical issue, but it affects how some visitors move around the site and removes context from those pages.
- Why an operational gap matters: An owner who decides at nine in the evening that the dog needs seeing has to wait for the phone line to open, and by then somebody else has usually taken the slot.

**Searches that find them:** veterinary practices, vet clinics, emergency vets, animal hospitals, veterinary specialists, equine vets
